rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE or CE from organizations approved under IC 25-1-4-1; at least 15 hours ACPE-accredited; at least 24 hours pharmacy-related; max 6 hours business, management or computer topics
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed under 6 months in the biennium: no hours; otherwise 1.25 hours per month. Licenses issued on or after July 1, 2025 need no CE for the 2026 renewal.
rules.carryover: No carry-forward; missing hours may be earned later and applied retroactively to the earlier biennium (not counted twice).
rules.alternatives: Inactive-status pharmacists need no CE. Hardship waivers possible (military service, incapacitating illness, other).
rules.audit_note: Sworn statement at renewal; random audit after every renewal period. Board page gives both 3 and 4 years for keeping certificates.
rules.notes: CE biennium runs January 1 of even years to December 31 of the next odd year; licenses renew by June 30 of even years (2026 renewal = CE from Jan 1 2024-Dec 31 2025).
